searchText: I just made this PR that allows republishing(forwarding) attestations which were ignored when they were received. They were ignored because the node didn't have the corresponding block. https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pull/719 Do other CLs forward the attestations when the block is received? Nimbus doesn't. This is a major change "allows republishing", i.e. "allows consuming significantly more resources". Is it attestation-specific? and this also disables a certain aspect of DoS-protection on the network The motivation is attestations. Do you process them when you receive the block? Like? I assume you'll limit the number of entries that are enqueued for later processing. The other alternative then is for attestors to just attest at 4s mark. How would they know if the peers have the block? ah, I see what you mean IGNORE turning into post-hoc ACCEPT ok, it's safety-neutral, but no, Nimbus doesn't do this

I just made this PR that allows republishing(forwarding) attestations which were ignored when they were received. They were ignored because the node didn't have the corresponding block.
https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pull/719

Do other CLs forward the attestations when the block is received?

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: Nimbus doesn't. This is a major change

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: "allows republishing", i.e. "allows consuming significantly more resources". Is it attestation-specific?

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: and this also disables a certain aspect of DoS-protection on the network

excerpts.author: sukunrt
excerpts.content:
The motivation is attestations.
Do you process them when you receive the block?

excerpts.author: sukunrt
excerpts.content:
Like? I assume you'll limit the number of entries that are enqueued for later processing.
The other alternative then is for attestors to just attest at 4s mark. How would they know if the peers have the block?

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: ah, I see what you mean

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: ok, it's safety-neutral, but no, Nimbus doesn't do this
